metadata.label: Cubic Hermite Step Function
metadata.description: C1-continuous cubic Hermite polynomial transition from h0 at x0 to h1 at x1.
metadata.provenance: Shabana, Dynamics of Multibody Systems (5th ed.); Cubic Hermite Interpolation

metadata.label: Quintic Step Function
metadata.description: C2-continuous quintic polynomial transition with zero first and second derivatives at endpoints.
metadata.provenance: Shabana, Dynamics of Multibody Systems (5th ed.); Quintic Minimum-Jerk Interpolation

metadata.label: Hertzian Impact Contact Force
metadata.description: Unilateral nonlinear Hertzian spring-damper contact force with cubic-step damping ramp.
metadata.provenance: Hunt & Crossley (1975) ASME J. Appl. Mech.; Flores & Lankarani, Contact Force Models

parameters.description: Penetration depth at which full damping cmax is reached

metadata.label: Bilateral Gap Stop Force
metadata.description: Two-sided clearance gap contact force engaging Hertzian IMPACT stops below x1 and above x2.
metadata.provenance: Flores & Lankarani, Contact Force Models for Multibody Dynamics (Springer, 2016)

metadata.label: Akima Cubic Spline Interpolation
metadata.description: Shape-preserving local Akima cubic spline interpolation minimizing overshoot.
metadata.provenance: Akima (1970) J. ACM 17(4):589-602, A New Method of Interpolation and Smooth Curve Fitting

metadata.label: Natural Cubic Spline Interpolation
metadata.description: C2-continuous piecewise cubic spline interpolation over tabulated data points.
metadata.provenance: de Boor, A Practical Guide to Splines (Springer, 2001)

metadata.label: Haversine Smooth Step Function
metadata.description: Smooth raised-cosine (haversine) transition from h0 at x0 to h1 at x1.
metadata.provenance: Standard Trigonometric Haversine Transition; Shabana, Multibody Systems

metadata.label: Simple Harmonic Function
metadata.description: Sinusoidal excitation a * sin(omega * (x - x0) - phi) + b.
metadata.provenance: Meirovitch, Fundamentals of Vibrations (McGraw-Hill, 2001)

metadata.label: Marker Distance Magnitude
metadata.description: Euclidean distance magnitude sqrt(dx^2 + dy^2 + dz^2) between I and J markers.
metadata.provenance: Haug, Computer Aided Kinematics and Dynamics of Mechanical Systems (1989)

metadata.label: X Displacement Measure
metadata.description: Translational displacement component along reference X axis between I and J markers.
metadata.provenance: Haug, Computer Aided Kinematics and Dynamics of Mechanical Systems (1989)

metadata.label: Y Displacement Measure
metadata.description: Translational displacement component along reference Y axis between I and J markers.
metadata.provenance: Haug, Computer Aided Kinematics and Dynamics of Mechanical Systems (1989)

metadata.label: Z Displacement Measure
metadata.description: Translational displacement component along reference Z axis between I and J markers.
metadata.provenance: Haug, Computer Aided Kinematics and Dynamics of Mechanical Systems (1989)

metadata.label: X Translational Velocity Measure
metadata.description: Relative translational velocity component along reference X axis between I and J markers.
metadata.provenance: Nikravesh, Computer-Aided Analysis of Mechanical Systems (Prentice Hall, 1988)

metadata.label: Y Translational Velocity Measure
metadata.description: Relative translational velocity component along reference Y axis between I and J markers.
metadata.provenance: Nikravesh, Computer-Aided Analysis of Mechanical Systems (Prentice Hall, 1988)

metadata.label: Z Translational Velocity Measure
metadata.description: Relative translational velocity component along reference Z axis between I and J markers.
metadata.provenance: Nikravesh, Computer-Aided Analysis of Mechanical Systems (Prentice Hall, 1988)

metadata.label: Radial Separation Velocity Measure
metadata.description: Time rate of change of separation distance d/dt(DM) = (r . v) / |r| between I and J markers.
metadata.provenance: Nikravesh, Computer-Aided Analysis of Mechanical Systems (Prentice Hall, 1988)

metadata.label: Revolute (Hinge) Joint
metadata.description: 1-DOF kinematic constraint permitting pure rotation about the common Z axis (5 constraints).
metadata.provenance: Shabana, Dynamics of Multibody Systems (5th ed.), Ch. 3 Revolute Joint

parameters.description: Number of unconstrained relative degrees of freedom

metadata.label: Translational (Prismatic) Joint
metadata.description: 1-DOF kinematic constraint permitting pure sliding along the common Z axis (5 constraints).
metadata.provenance: Shabana, Dynamics of Multibody Systems (5th ed.), Ch. 3 Prismatic Joint

parameters.description: Number of unconstrained relative degrees of freedom

metadata.label: Spherical (Ball-and-Socket) Joint
metadata.description: 3-DOF rotational constraint enforcing coincident marker origins (3 translational constraints).
metadata.provenance: Haug, Computer Aided Kinematics and Dynamics of Mechanical Systems (1989), Ch. 9

metadata.label: Universal (Cardan) Joint
metadata.description: 2-DOF intersecting-axis rotational constraint enforcing orthogonal I-Z and J-Z axes (4 constraints).
metadata.provenance: Nikravesh, Computer-Aided Analysis of Mechanical Systems (1988), Universal Joint

metadata.label: Cylindrical Joint
metadata.description: 2-DOF kinematic constraint permitting collinear translation and rotation along Z (4 constraints).
metadata.provenance: Shabana, Dynamics of Multibody Systems (5th ed.), Ch. 3 Cylindrical Joint

metadata.label: Fixed (Weld) Joint
metadata.description: 0-DOF rigid attachment removing all 6 relative translational and rotational degrees of freedom.
metadata.provenance: Haug, Computer Aided Kinematics and Dynamics of Mechanical Systems (1989)

metadata.label: Planar Joint
metadata.description: 3-DOF constraint keeping I marker origin in the J-XY plane and Z axes parallel (3 constraints).
metadata.provenance: Nikravesh, Computer-Aided Analysis of Mechanical Systems (1988), Planar Joint

metadata.label: Constant Velocity (CV) Joint
metadata.description: 2-DOF homokinetic drive joint transmitting identical shaft angular velocity across articulation angles.
metadata.provenance: Gillespie, Fundamentals of Vehicle Dynamics (SAE, 1992); Homokinetic CV Kinematics

metadata.label: Hooke Joint
metadata.description: 2-DOF gimbal/Hooke coupling with orthogonal cross-pin axes transmitting torque across shaft misalignment.
metadata.provenance: Shabana, Dynamics of Multibody Systems (5th ed.), Universal / Hooke Joint

metadata.label: Point-Curve Constraint
metadata.description: Higher-pair 4-DOF constraint restricting marker I origin to lie on a parametric 3D curve on body J.
metadata.provenance: Haug, Computer Aided Kinematics and Dynamics (1989); Higher-Pair Cam/Curve Constraints

metadata.label: Prescribed Kinematic Motion Driver
metadata.description: Rheonomic constraint prescribing displacement, velocity, or acceleration as a function of time.
metadata.provenance: Shabana, Dynamics of Multibody Systems (5th ed.), Ch. 3 Driving Constraints

metadata.label: Translational / Rotational Spring-Damper
metadata.description: Linear/cubic-nonlinear viscoelastic Kelvin-Voigt spring-damper element with preload and free length.
metadata.provenance: Shabana, Dynamics of Multibody Systems (5th ed.), TSDA / RSDA Force Elements

metadata.label: 6-DOF Elastomeric Bushing
metadata.description: 6-DOF compliant translational and rotational viscoelastic mount between I and J markers.
metadata.provenance: Blundell & Harty, The Multibody Systems Approach to Vehicle Dynamics (2nd ed., 2015)

metadata.label: 3D Timoshenko Elastic Beam Element
metadata.description: 6-DOF massless linear Timoshenko beam compliance element with axial, bending, shear, and torsion.
metadata.provenance: Przemieniecki, Theory of Matrix Structural Analysis (Dover, 1985)

metadata.label: 6-DOF Coupled Stiffness-Damping Field
metadata.description: General 6x6 stiffness and damping matrix field force element between I and J markers.
metadata.provenance: Shabana, Dynamics of Multibody Systems (5th ed.); General 6-DOF Compliance Matrix

metadata.label: Single-Component Action-Reaction Force
metadata.description: Scalar translational or rotational action-reaction force applied along the I-J line of action.
metadata.provenance: Haug, Computer Aided Kinematics and Dynamics of Mechanical Systems (1989)

metadata.label: 3-Component Vector Force
metadata.description: Three orthogonal translational force components (Fx, Fy, Fz) resolved in reference marker frame.
metadata.provenance: Haug, Computer Aided Kinematics and Dynamics of Mechanical Systems (1989)

metadata.label: 6-Component General Force & Torque
metadata.description: Full 6-component spatial wrench (Fx, Fy, Fz, Tx, Ty, Tz) resolved in reference marker frame.
metadata.provenance: Shabana, Dynamics of Multibody Systems (5th ed.), Generalized Spatial Forces

metadata.label: 3D Geometry Impact & Coulomb Friction Contact
metadata.description: 3D solid-to-solid Hertzian normal impact with regularized Stribeck/Coulomb tangential friction.
metadata.provenance: Flores & Lankarani (2016); Regularized Coulomb Friction for Multibody Contact

metadata.label: Pacejka Magic Formula 2002 Tire
metadata.description: Semi-empirical Pacejka Magic Formula (PAC2002) longitudinal/lateral tire force and aligning torque.
metadata.provenance: Pacejka, Tyre and Vehicle Dynamics (3rd ed., Butterworth-Heinemann, 2012)

parameters.description: Longitudinal peak friction coefficient mu_x (D_x = mu_x * Fz)
Lateral peak friction coefficient mu_y (D_y = mu_y * Fz)
Nominal pneumatic trail t_p0 for aligning torque M_z
Combined-slip longitudinal weighting slope factor B_xalpha
Combined-slip longitudinal weighting shape factor C_xalpha
Combined-slip lateral weighting slope factor B_ykappa
Combined-slip lateral weighting shape factor C_ykappa
Camber thrust equivalent slip stiffness factor

metadata.label: Fiala Analytical Tire Model
metadata.description: Analytical parabolic-pressure brush tire model for longitudinal, lateral, and aligning forces.
metadata.provenance: Fiala (1954) VDI Zeitschrift 96(29):973-979; Blundell & Harty (2015)

metadata.label: University of Arizona (UA) Tire Model
metadata.description: Combined-slip friction-ellipse analytical tire model with camber thrust and rolling resistance.
metadata.provenance: Gim & Nikravesh (1990) Int. J. Vehicle Design 11(6):589-603, Analytical Model of Pneumatic Tyres

metadata.label: Flat Planar Road Surface
metadata.description: Infinite planar road surface at constant elevation z0 with uniform friction scaling mu.
metadata.provenance: Pacejka, Tyre and Vehicle Dynamics (3rd ed., 2012); Standard Flat Road Profile

metadata.label: Cleat / Speed-Bump Road Profile
metadata.description: Flat road with a trapezoidal or haversine cleat obstacle for ride and harshness evaluation.
metadata.provenance: ISO 8608 & Pacejka (2012); Transient Cleat Envelopment Road Test Profile
